section: Reports Suite > Work In Progress > WIP - Summary Strip
title: Strip and table agree per work order: a completed job holds no Remaining
refs: SV-8661 (WIP spec v28 2026-08-24 Story 4a S4a-R3 - the summary strip and the table always agree for the same work order; no figure may report Remaining that the row does not show, and no row may show Remaining that no figure counts; Story 4a was raised by SV-9119 and carries no Jira story key of its own, so the owning story is Story 5 / SV-8661, which specifies the summary figures this requirement reconciles)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Earned and Remaining columns are turned on in the Work In Progress report.
3. A ZZAUTOTEST work order exists with at least one approved labor line and one approved parts line that have only been partly performed, so the row shows a Remaining above $0.00.
4. That work order's status is In Progress, so it is listed in the "Approved - partially completed" tab.
5. At least one other work order is listed in the "Approved - not started" tab, so the floor is not made up of the seeded work order alone.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report and select the "Approved - partially completed" tab.
2. Find the seeded work order's row and write down its Remaining value.
3. Write down the summary strip figures Remaining Work, Work Orders Not Started, Remaining Work on Open Work Orders and Work Orders Ready to Invoice.
4. Open the seeded work order and set its status to Complete.
5. Go back to the Work In Progress report and reload it, then select the "Completed" tab and find the same work order's row.
6. Read that row's Remaining value.
7. Read the same four summary strip figures again and compare each one with what you wrote down in step 3.
8. Look through the "Approved - partially completed" and "Approved - not started" tabs for the seeded work order.
expected:
1. Before the work order is completed, its row on the "Approved - partially completed" tab shows a Remaining above $0.00, and that amount is part of both Remaining Work and Remaining Work on Open Work Orders.
2. After the work order is completed, it is listed in the "Completed" tab and its row shows Remaining of $0.00.
3. No summary figure still reports any Remaining for that work order. Remaining Work and Remaining Work on Open Work Orders have each gone down by exactly the Remaining the row used to show, and Work Orders Not Started is unchanged because the work order was never in that tab.
4. Work Orders Ready to Invoice has gone up by the completed work order's Earned value.
5. The work order is no longer listed in either of the two "Approved" tabs, so nothing counts it twice.
6. The rule holds in both directions for every work order on screen: a figure never reports Remaining that the work order's own row does not show, and a row that shows Remaining above $0.00 is always counted by at least one figure. Adding up the Remaining shown on the two "Approved" tabs still gives exactly the Remaining Work figure.
7. The strip and the table are two views of the same money, so a work order that reads $0.00 Remaining in the table must read as nothing in the strip.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (Story 4a, S4a-R3), read on 28 August 2026, under epic SV-8582 and its summary-strip story SV-8661. Story 4a was raised by SV-9119 and carries no Jira story key of its own.
